official.deadline_note: FCT states the call was open from 2 March to 5:00 pm (Lisbon time) on 31 March 2026, and the published schedule confirms opening of applications 2 March 2026 (12h) and closing 31 March 2026 (17h). Applications submitted by any other means are not accepted.
official.application_cycle: 2026 Call for PhD Studentships - Regular Line of Application: announced 25 February 2026, applications 2-31 March 2026, contracting institution validation 6-17 April 2026, preliminary results 31 July 2026, final results expected from the beginning of November 2026
official.status_note: The 2026 call application window closed on 31 March 2026. Provisional results were announced on 31 July 2026 and final results are expected from the beginning of November 2026; the next annual call had no published call sheet on the pages read.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Selected applicants receive 'a monthly allowance, as well as other complementary support in accordance with the amounts set out by the RBI, such as tuition fees, support for additional training activities, presentation of work at scientific meetings, personal accident insurance and, when applicable, travel and relocation costs.'
benefits: Presentation of work at scientific meetings
Travel and relocation costs when applicable
For the 2026 call: 1,600 studentships foreseen, 600 of them in a non-academic environment
Financed from the State Budget and, when eligible, from the European Social Fund under the PESSOAS 2030 programme
eligibility: Portuguese citizens, citizens of EU member states, citizens from third-party states, stateless citizens and citizens beneficiaries of political refugee status
Applicants enrolled in, or complying with the requirements to enrol in, a PhD programme to obtain a doctoral degree

Candidates who want to develop PhD research in any academic institution, national or international, including public and private higher education institutions, R&D units, Associated Laboratories and other private non-profit R&D institutions

Mandatory conditions: not to have benefited from any PhD studentship or PhD in Industry studentship directly funded by FCT regardless of duration; not to hold a doctoral degree; to live in Portugal on a permanent and habitual basis if applying to a both in Portugal and abroad or entirely abroad studentship, which applies to applicants with Portuguese and with foreign citizenship
requirements: Applications and supporting documents must be submitted online exclusively using the available application form at https://myfct.fct.pt, selecting the regular line of application and clicking 'start application'
Applications or additional information submitted by any other means will not be accepted
The contracting institution indicated in the application form must validate the application through the myFCT platform within 10 working days; unvalidated applications are excluded
Remaining admissibility requirements are in section 4 of the Notice of the Call
documents: Supporting documents listed in the RBI and in the Notice of the Call
Proof of recognition or conversion of degrees or diplomas awarded by foreign institutions, which was a required document in this call
For CV-related matters, a CIENCIAVITAE curriculum
selection_criteria: Applications graded from zero (0.000, minimum) to five (5.000, maximum) in three criteria: A - Merit of the Applicant, B - Merit of the Work Plan, C - Merit of the Hosting Conditions
Relative weights: Criterion A 30%, Criterion B 40%, Criterion C 30%
Merit of the applicant uses two sub-criteria weighted equally: academic career 50% and personal CV 50%
Applications with a final classification lower than 3.000 are not eligible for a studentship
Ties are broken by weighted average, then Criterion B, then Criterion A, then Criterion C
Evaluation is performed by panels of experts with recognised experience and scientific merit
coverage: Monthly allowance according to the amounts set out by the RBI
Support for additional training activities and presentation of work at scientific meetings
Travel and relocation costs when applicable
Amounts are updated annually by the FCT Governing Board in line with the national minimum wage; for 2026 all monthly maintenance grants rose by EUR 50 with effect from 1 January 2026
For the 2026 regular line: 3,628 applications, 1,000 approved, total funding value EUR 90,625,000, approval rate 28%
application_method: Read the Notice of the Call, Evaluation Guide, Application Guide, Ethics Guide and FAQ published as Call Documents
Prepare and maintain a CIENCIAVITAE curriculum
Open https://myfct.fct.pt, select the regular line of application and click 'start application'
Upload all supporting documents listed in the RBI and the Notice of the Call
Nominate the contracting institution and confirm it validates the application within the 10 working days allowed
official.application_route: Apply online only via https://myfct.fct.pt, selecting the regular line of application; no other submission route is accepted.
official.citizenship_residency: Portuguese citizens, EU citizens, citizens of third-party states, stateless citizens and citizens beneficiaries of political refugee status are eligible; permanent and habitual residence in Portugal is required for both-in-Portugal-and-abroad and entirely-abroad studentships, applying equally to Portuguese and foreign citizens
official.international_eligibility: Yes - citizens of third-party states and stateless persons are explicitly eligible; the FCT call pages are published in English
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: All scientific areas are covered by the regular line; the separate specific line targets work plans carried out mostly in non-academic institutions
official.research_requirement: The applicant must have a research work plan to be carried out at a contracting institution, which is assessed as Criterion B (Merit of the Work Plan) carrying the highest weight at 40%
official.description: PhD studentships aim to fund research activities leading to the award of the PhD degree, and are granted in compliance with the FCT Regulation for Studentships and Fellowships (RBI) and the Research Fellowship Holder Statute (EBI); the regular line covers all scientific areas and research carried out in scientific and academic institutions.
official.program_type: National research council doctoral grant (Foundation for Science and Technology, FCT)

applicant_utility.summary: FCT's evaluation is unusually transparent, so game it directly: Criterion B, the merit of the work plan, carries 40% against 30% each for applicant merit and hosting conditions, and anything scoring under 3.000 is dead. The work plan needs a named contracting institution that will validate it in myFCT within the 10 working days it is given, because an unvalidated application is excluded before evaluation even starts. Check the hard bars before you invest time: no prior FCT-funded studentship of any length, no doctoral degree, and permanent habitual residence in Portugal if you want a Portugal-and-abroad or fully-abroad studentship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Researchers already enrolled in, or eligible for, a Portuguese PhD programme who have a strong work plan and a host institution prepared to contract the studentship, and who have never held an FCT studentship.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you hold no doctoral degree and have never held an FCT-funded PhD or PhD-in-Industry studentship of any duration
Confirm you live in Portugal permanently and habitually if you are considering a both-in-Portugal-and-abroad or entirely-abroad studentship - this applies to foreign citizens too
Secure the contracting institution's agreement before you submit, and confirm it will validate the application within the 10 working days it is allowed
Read the Notice of the Call, Evaluation Guide, Application Guide and Ethics Guide in full before drafting
Write the work plan with Criterion B in mind, since it carries the single largest weight at 40%
Build a current CIENCIAVITAE curriculum and use the CIENCIAVITAE Guide published with the call
Start foreign-degree recognition early - DGES has at least 30 days by law, and this call was disrupted by exactly that backlog
common_rejection_risks: Final classification below 3.000, which makes the application ineligible for a studentship regardless of ranking
The contracting institution failing to validate the application within its 10 working days, which excludes it from the call outright
Having held any FCT-funded studentship previously, however short
Applying for an abroad studentship while not permanently and habitually resident in Portugal
Leaving foreign-degree recognition to the last days before the deadline
Submitting anything by email or post instead of the myFCT form, which FCT states will not be accepted
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition, a monthly allowance and personal accident insurance are covered, and travel and relocation costs only when applicable, so installation costs and anything the RBI does not list as complementary support remain yours; FCT does not publish the monthly figure in text, so build your budget from the RBI table rather than from any secondary site.
document_audit: Supporting documents are those listed in the RBI and the Notice of the Call - read both, since FCT points to them rather than listing documents inline
Degrees or diplomas awarded by foreign institutions need proof of recognition or conversion, and this was an admissibility item in the 2026 call
Keep the CV in CIENCIAVITAE and up to date, since questions about CV creation go to the CIENCIAVITAE helpdesk
For preliminary hearing, arguments must be submitted via the myFCT portal within 10 working days of the provisional results (by 11:59 pm on 14 August 2026 for this round)
alerts: The 2026 round was heavily oversubscribed: 3,628 applications for 1,000 approved grants in the regular line, a 28% approval rate
Final results for the 2026 call are only expected from the beginning of November 2026, roughly seven months after the call opened
Funding comes from the State Budget and, when eligible, ESF money under PESSOAS 2030, so the annual call sheet and calendar are published on FCT's calls page
The call timetable is published on the call page - February announcement, March window, April validation, summer preliminary results - so plan a year ahead, not a month ahead
Monthly maintenance grant amounts are revised each January in line with the national minimum wage, so a figure quoted from a previous year understates the current award
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Read the Notice of the Call and guides, secure a contracting institution, complete the myFCT application with all RBI and Notice documents uploaded by 31 March at 17:00, make sure the institution validates within 10 working days, then wait for provisional results with the 10-day preliminary-hearing route in reserve.
